the α lamellar of the composite is equiaxed-like and exhibited a low aspect ratio, especially in the vicinity of reinforcement.

There was an amount of equiaxed β grains (pointed with dotted purple line) decorated along the prior coarse β grain boundary that was similar to a string of neck lace, which was a result of discontinuous dynamic recrystallization (dDRX).

the silicide was assumed to be an S2-type silicide. As one can see, the morphology of those silicide (small black particle in Fig. 3) was granular and spheroid ranging from 20–40 nm, and its small size hinders dislocation that can achieve great elevated temperature strength and creep resistance.
the morphology of α colony in matrix was still unabridged even when the α/β phase boundaries might be bend (Fig. 3b).
